summary: E2E validated: exam → autograde → sync to Registro Auxiliar WORKS. Created /app/backend/tests/test_exam_to_register_e2e.py (5 tests, all passing). Flow: admin@elroble.edu created an exam in Música (subject_id=grades-diagnostics) linked to register_column='t1' for BIMESTRE I (active period 093a0bee-92c4-449c-b82c-942f16847759), added a multiple-choice question with 1 correct option, published the exam, then student Magno (mickycalle65@gmail.com) started attempt → saved answer (correct) → submitted. Submit returned score=10.0 max_score=10.0 percentage=100.0 correct_count=1. GET /api/grades/register/{subject}/{section}/{period} confirmed the value 20 (vigesimal) appears in the student row under the static field 'rf_r1' (mapping t1→rf_r1 from COLUMN_FIELD_MAP in register_sync.py). Tested both static-mapped columns (io→act_co, re→act_re, t1→rf_r1) — all synced correctly. Backend integration is rock solid.

critical_code_review_comments: register_sync.py: COLUMN_FIELD_MAP is the single source of truth for static→canonical field mapping; the mapping for io/re/t1..t5/c1..c2/p1..p3 is correct and matches the register row keys returned by GET /api/grades/register. Good.

exams.py:545 create_exam auto-resolves the active period server-side (db.academic_periods activo:true) — even though clients pass period_id, that value is ignored and the active one wins. Worth documenting in the API for future agents.

exams.py save-answer expects singular 'selected_option_id' (not plural 'selected_option_ids' or 'answer'). The original problem statement payload hints in iteration_204 were misleading — adjust the doc if any.
register_sync.sync_single_student_exam is awaited inline at submit, so the grade is guaranteed to be in student_grades by the time the HTTP response returns. Excellent for testability.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. The exam-to-register E2E flow works end-to-end as designed: submit_exam_attempt awaits sync_single_student_exam, which converts the percentage to vigesimal (100% → 20) and upserts into student_grades using the static field map from COLUMN_FIELD_MAP (e.g., t1 → rf_r1). GET /api/grades/register returns the row with rf_r1=20 immediately after submit.
